mapper.insert: INSERT INTO downlink_outbox ( tenant_id, device_id, message_id, type, topic, payload, status, attempts, max_attempts, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{deviceId}, #{messageId}, #{type}, #{topic}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRetryAt}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (device_id, message_id) DO NOTHING
